title: Sprite bbox y extracted bottom-up (Blender) but consumed top-down (raylib) — no flip anywhere; sprites sample mostly-empty canvas rows
detail: Blender img.pixels rows start bottom-left; raylib source rects start top-left. No y-flip in the diff. Bboxes are off-center (house y=55, h=88 of 256), so every sprite's sample window lands ~57px above its content.
recommended_fix: Convert on write in gen_sprites.py (y_top = RES - y - h) or flip in sprite_blit; regenerate sprites.json and re-bless affected goldens.

title: puck_3's second LED ring is fully embedded inside the disc and can never render
detail: led2 spheres: center z=0.11, radius 0.05r, horizontal 0.90r. Disc: z 0..0.16, radius r. For ports=16 (r=0.676) sphere top z≈0.144<0.16 and horizontal extent<0.676 — fully occluded. High-tier ring(s) signature lost.
recommended_fix: Raise ring 2 above the face surface (z≈0.20, matching ring 1's z=0.20) and regenerate puck_3 + sprites.json.

title: draw_packets header comment still describes the pre-7.1 lane-order pile the new doorstep fan replaced
detail: The unchanged header still claims queued packets 'pile at the departure node in lane order — the serialization visual'; the new code piles them at the doorstep in an id-keyed fan instead.
recommended_fix: Amend the draw_packets header comment to describe the doorstep-fan behavior.

title: effect_ui_press comment claims 'popover-first order' but banner/SLA hit-tests run before popover_click
detail: Comment says popover-first, but crisis_banner_click and sla_focus_click are checked before popover_click — on overlap the banner/SLA row wins over the popover.
recommended_fix: Move the banner/SLA checks after popover_click, or reword the comment to match the actual precedence.

title: crisis card constants (card_w=440, line_h=17) duplicated in crisis_banner_rect and draw_crisis_banner despite the single-source claim

title: SLA focus hit rect (x=12, w=720) is narrower than the drawn selection chip (x=8, w=740)
detail: The visible focused chip spans x 8..748 while the clickable region spans x 12..732; clicks on ~16px of the highlighted chip's edges do nothing.
recommended_fix: Derive both the hit rect and the chip from one shared rect definition (same x and width).

title: sprites_load leaks already-loaded textures on partial failure and its bool result is ignored at both call sites — silent fallback
detail: On first failed texture or JSON parse, previously loaded textures are never unloaded; the CWD-relative SPRITES_DIR plus ignored return means a wrong-CWD run silently degrades to primitives with no diagnostic.
recommended_fix: Unload loaded textures on failure; log (or assert in the harness) when sprites_load returns false.

title: camera_update re-derives the fit scale inline instead of sharing view_compute's formula — drift risk between app-at-rest and golden frames
evidence:
fit := min(f32(v.win_w)/v.world_w, f32(v.win_h)/v.world_h)
	v.scale = fit * app.cam_zoom
	v.off_x = f32(v.win_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale
	v.off_y = f32(v.win_h)/2 - app.cam_wy * v.scale
detail: The harness goldens pin view_compute's scale; the app now overrides scale/off every frame from a re-implemented inline fit. If view_compute's formula ever changes (padding, clamping), app-at-rest diverges from goldens.
recommended_fix: Factor the fit computation into one shared render helper that both view_compute and camera_update call.

title: sprites.json bbox parse checks structure but not value ranges; comment overclaims 'any malformation fails the sheet'
detail: Parse validates only type/count. Negative x/y or boxes beyond the 256px canvas load fine and reach DrawTexturePro's source rect (line 142); only w/h<=0 are guarded downstream (line 138). Reachable solely by hand-editing the committed sidecar, so note-level.
recommended_fix: In sprites_parse_boxes reject entries where any value <0, w/h <=0, or x+w/y+h exceed the 256 canvas, returning false so the sheet falls back to primitives, matching the line-70 comment.

title: 7.1 tier-band width formula (wire × 2.2) restated in four render sites across two files
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:274:  width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:290:  band := width * 2.2
app/render/view.odin:665:  base_w := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:668:  width := base_w * 2.2 - 2.0 * lane_gutter(v) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:798:  width := (tier_pipe_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[bi]) + f32(bundles.bundle_count[bi]-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:799:  halo := width * 2.2 + 6 * v.scale // 7.1: the selection halo hugs the WIDE band
app/render/crisis.odin:143:  band := (tier_pipe_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[b]) + f32(max(0, int(bundles.bundle_count[b])-1))*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale * 2.2

recommended_fix: Hoist bundle_band_width(v, tier, count) -> f32 beside tier_pipe_width/lane_gutter; derive the band, rider inner width, selection halo, and crisis outline from it.

title: Pipe band width (×2.2) formula restated in four draw sites instead of one shared helper
